name: TC-TI-002 — 终止后迭代只读展示 [P1]
description: 验证CANCELLED状态迭代只读展示，不展示主流程action，店铺释放名额

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.textContent; const hasTerminateInfo = text.includes('已终止') || text.includes('CANCELLED') || text.includes('终止'); const noMainAction = !document.querySelector('[class*=bottom-action] button, [class*=main-action] button'); const steps = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*=step-item]')).map(s => s.textContent.trim()); return { hasTerminateInfo, noMainAction, steps }; })()

_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 进入已终止迭代详情
2. 验证展示终止信息
3. 验证不展示主流程action
4. 验证内容只读
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 展示已终止状态
2. 不展示Brief提交/确认/上传/审核/复核/归档等action
3. 内容只读可查看历史
4. 时间线展示终止事件
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/终止迭代
